scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm calling to check on the status of my loan application. I submitted it a few weeks ago, and I wanted to know if there's been any update. I'm wondering if it's been approved, denied, or if you still need more information from me.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. The loan is a 60-month conventional loan for $1,145,000 at an interest rate of 7.550%. The property value is $1,415,000.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Can you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record shows that your loan does not have any negative amortization features and it is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA. The loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user:
Great, I'm glad to hear that there are no high-cost or negative amortization flags. I appreciate your help. I think that's all the information I need for now. Thank you for your assistance!

<Very Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and provided all the information I needed. I'm satisfied with the outcome and the service I received.
